description: A private network, subnet and router whose gateway sits on the cloud's external network, for openstack-instance servers to attach to.

parameters.name: externalNetworkId
parameters.description: Id of the external Neutron network the router's gateway sits on, usually the cloud's public network.

parameters.name: networkName
parameters.description: Name of the private network, its subnet and the router; without it they take the composite's namespace, plexsphere-project-<project-id>.

parameters.name: cidr
parameters.description: IPv4 CIDR of the private subnet.

parameters.name: dnsNameserver
parameters.description: One DNS resolver the subnet hands out through DHCP; without it the cloud's default resolver.
